components.name: Princess suite room shell
components.function: Reserved princess-suite room reference missing; one coherent design overview
components.construction: Four views of same source-compatible princess bedroom and dressing alcove: rose/ivory marble, gold framing, blue/rose windows, a human-scale canopy bed cluster, cupboards, carpets, lamps, curtains, birthday flowers and memory display. Source furniture vocabulary, inferred room layout. Keep meaningful open circulation and stable openings across views.

components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting

components.notes: All four requested room views, one bed per view, three east window bays, south entry, dressing alcove and ceiling section are present. Materials follow GEN-24 furniture vocabulary; room layout itself is new. Plan, arrival view and cutaway place reading southwest and memory display southeast. Opposite view B appears to swap these two corner furniture groups. View B is atmosphere reference only; saved proposed_layout and the top plan control these corner positions. Printed fixed-layout labels are generator output, not a verified geometric guarantee. Actual furniture dimensions, room openings and ceiling bay correspondence must be enforced in the model. Source backs, dimensions, repeat patterns, inter-view parity and physical attachment remain unverified. Whole-sheet generation does not prove individual meshes are separable.
